# Agent Shadi Product Knowledge

> A concise map of the product-specific operating knowledge used by Agent Shadi. Retrieve only the sections relevant to the current task.

## Core purpose
- [Agent purpose](agent-purpose.md): specialist role, user-control boundaries and response behavior.
- [Studio workflow map](workflow-map.md): dashboard, workflow builder, sources, inbox, extraction, review, cleanup and exports.

## Collection and data operations
- [Web connectors](web-connectors.md): channel identity, DOM selectors, validation, navigation and persistence.
- [Collection troubleshooting](collection-troubleshooting.md): evidence-first diagnosis and safe recovery.
- [Data lifecycle](data-lifecycle.md): raw source messages versus structured extraction records and database counts.
- [Schema and variables](schema-and-variables.md): field contracts, prompts, types and normalization.
- [Golden data](golden-data.md): validation, cleanup, deduplication, review and provenance.
